title.text: BRAVIA Home — three Japanese keycap themes

how.text:
How it would work on the TV

• Tiles become keycaps: same shape and size for every app, name as the legend, katakana as the sub-legend (like Japanese keycap sets). App banners can go back inside the cap if you prefer.
• The background scene changes by itself with season and time of day, using only the TV clock: no internet needed.
• It never snows here, so 'Yuki' would be a winter (Dec–Feb) night mood, not real weather. Real weather (rain in monsoon, fog in winter) needs one tiny request an hour to a free weather service: optional.
• Falling snow/petals are a handful of light dots drawn ~30 times a second, paused when an app is open.

pick.text:
Try it: press Play on a board and hover the caps — the focused key lifts and lights up, as it would when you move with the remote.

Tell me: one theme, or all three rotating by season (Sakura spring, Sumi monsoon/autumn, Yuki winter)?
